name: Keepeek
description: Integrates the Keepeek digital-asset-management (DAM) platform with Drupal media.
project_description:
Keepeek Digital Asset Management platform centralizes all your organization's images, videos, web, print and rich media content. This module allow connecting your Drupal website to Keepeek platform assets

 Keepeek module video presentation 

 Features 
 This module provides you a user friendly way to browse yours assets to insert them in the media library. Keepeek media library assets are connected to your DAM platform : if you update the picture in your DAM platform, it will be up to date in your Drupal website !

 Some features we provide include:

 
 Browse your assets using Keepeek search and advanced filters 
 Insert pictures and videos in your pages 
 Dynamic editor to crop and resize your pictures either using a point of interest or with the crop feature 
 Navigate through your media collections or shared collections 
 Explore your folders 
 
 

 

 

 Post-Installation 
 Contact Keepeek team to enable the Drupal module account.

 After installing the module, you should add a new Keepeek Media type following this procedure :

 
 Install this module Keepeek in Extensions > List . 
 Configure Keepeek plugin in Configuration > Keepeek 
 Create a new Keepeek media type in Structure > Media Type 
 
 Click add new media type 
 Fill the name 
 Select Keepeek as media source 
 Source field: select an existing field or by default a new one will be created automatically 
 JSON field: select an existing field or by default a new one will be created automatically 
 Click on create 
 In manage display tab:
 
 for Keepeek field, select Keepeek format 
 Make sure JSON field is not displayed 
 Save fields display 
 
 
 
 
 Associate create media type in content type in Structure > Content type 
 
 Click on manage fields of a content type 
 Click on Create new field 
 In combo box, select Media field and fill the label 
 Click on Add 
 Click on Save field parameter 
 In Keepeek field parameters , select Keepeek media type 
 
 
 Keepeek module is ready ! 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 This project rely on media library core module.
